items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...he either called him Papa or Oscar. [INTERVIEWEE] That's the white person who called him Papa or Oscar.

ctx.x: These guys have got so many nicknames, it's confusing. And, and the thing you called him, he answered. He didn't care. He didn't care. He didn't care. He said he was on there. And the white people always, he either called him Papa or Oscar.
That's the white person who called him Papa or Oscar. And all of them know, he knows when they were David.
And he didn't care. He didn't care. He didn't care.
